title: 590. Lonely Pixel I

examples.explanation: Each black pixel sits alone in its row and column.
Every black pixel shares its row or column with another black pixel.
The single black pixel has no company in its row or column.

hints: Count the black pixels in each row and each column first.
A black pixel is lonely exactly when its row count and its column count are both 1.
Rust note: the picture arrives as its encoded string; parse it before counting.
